strings.STARTUP_DEV_HELP:
F12 captures the screen. Export diagnostics from the pause menu.

Open the Developer Game launcher, then choose New Game > Sandbox. The footer shows DEV MODE. Saves stay separate.

Manual launch: --dev-game enters developer mode directly. Ctrl+Shift+F12 toggles mode only in a --devtools launch.

strings.RESEARCH_PURPOSE_SPACE_ASSEMBLY: Develops methods for assembling and validating orbital structures.
strings.RESEARCH_PURPOSE_PROSPECTING: Develops ways to locate and assess resource deposits for later mining.
strings.RESEARCH_PURPOSE_ASTEROID_MINING: Develops controlled extraction methods for accessible asteroid material.
strings.RESEARCH_PURPOSE_VACUUM_REFINING: Studies processing and purification methods that work in vacuum.
strings.RESEARCH_PURPOSE_ORBITAL_MANUFACTURING: Develops repeatable manufacturing methods for orbital industry.
strings.RESEARCH_PURPOSE_ORBITAL_SHIPYARD: Develops the engineering basis for an orbital shipyard.
strings.RESEARCH_PURPOSE_GRAVITY: Builds methods to measure gravity for advanced propulsion research.
strings.RESEARCH_PURPOSE_FIELD_THEORY: Develops mathematical and experimental tools for controllable field research.
strings.RESEARCH_PURPOSE_WARP_METRIC: Investigates metric models relevant to spacetime-field research.
strings.RESEARCH_PURPOSE_EXOTIC_COUPLING: Investigates how exotic energy sources could couple to controlled fields.
strings.RESEARCH_PURPOSE_WARP_CONTROL: Develops control methods for stable laboratory-scale distortion fields.
strings.RESEARCH_PURPOSE_WARP_DRIVE: Develops a vessel-scale prototype for interstellar transit.
strings.RESEARCH_PURPOSE_GENERIC: Explores a practical {0} approach in the {1} field.
strings.RESEARCH_BENEFIT_ORBITAL_MANUFACTURING: At mature completion, Orbital Industry enables spacecraft construction and makes the Orbital Shipyard project available once the Orbital Launch Complex is complete.
strings.RESEARCH_BENEFIT_ORBITAL_SHIPYARD: Improves the knowledge base for operating orbital yards. Building a yard still requires its separate construction project and launch-complex prerequisite.
strings.RESEARCH_BENEFIT_WARP_DRIVE: A demonstrated result supports limited interstellar transit. Ships still require an operational Orbital Shipyard.
strings.RESEARCH_BENEFIT_SPACE_ASSEMBLY: Provides assembly and validation methods needed before large orbital manufacturing can be attempted.
strings.RESEARCH_BENEFIT_PROSPECTING: Improves the basis for selecting targets before an extraction program is proposed.
strings.RESEARCH_BENEFIT_ASTEROID_MINING: Provides extraction methods needed before asteroid-material operations can be developed.
strings.RESEARCH_BENEFIT_VACUUM_REFINING: Provides vacuum-processing knowledge needed for orbital manufacturing work.
strings.RESEARCH_BENEFIT_GENERIC: Contributes knowledge for the next practical step in this field. Research alone does not construct facilities or grant an immediate production bonus.
